MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Make a difference everyday

HammondCare provides expert aged care, home care, dementiacareand palliative care for older people, regardless of circumstances, beliefs,backgroundor financial situation. We are led by our not-for-profit, Christian foundations and backed by research and clinical expertise.

When it comes to our people - those we serve and those who serve - we are committed to inclusion across race, culture, ethnicity, gender, sex, sexuality,religionand ability. In our innovative residences, our hospitals, or in client homes, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for older people with complex needs.

We've been caring for people for over 90 years - so, if you love to care, join us, and make a career move that matters.

It'snot just care.It'sHammondCare.

About The Role

At HammondCare, technology plays a critical role in improving quality of life for people with complex health and aged care needs.We'reseekingan experienced and strategic technology leader to join our executive team asGeneral Manager - DigitalProducts&Platforms.

This is a significant leadership role,reporting to the CIO, you will ownHammondCare'sdigitalplatforms &productscapability, leading the teams responsible for building, evolving, and optimising the platforms that underpin care delivery, workforce productivity, business operations, and future innovation.

You'llhelp shape a modern product and platform operating model, bringing together product management, engineering, agile delivery, platform operations, architecture alignment, vendor management, and value realisation into a single, high-performing capability.

This is an opportunity to lead digital transformation at scale while ensuring our core platformsremainreliable, secure, integrated, and ready to support emerging AI and automation opportunities.

This is apermanentroleworking at St Leonards with hybrid opportunities.

Responsibilities

Define and execute the strategy and roadmap forHammondCare'sdigital products, platforms, and enterprise systems, ensuring alignment to organisational priorities and future growth

Lead multiple agile squads across Salesforce, ERP, care systems, integration services, and digital experience platforms, creating a high-performing delivery culture focused on outcomes

Establish and evolve a modern productand platform operating model that aligns product management, engineering, delivery, support, and business teams around customer value

Drive engineering excellence through Agile, DevOps, automation, quality engineering, secure-by-design principles, and modern delivery practices

Lead product adoption, platform utilisation, and benefits realisation, ensuring technology investments deliver measurable business and operational outcomes

Partner with Data, AI & Analytics leaders toestablishAI-ready platforms, ensuring the foundations for analytics, automation, and responsible AI adoption are in place

Lead strategic vendor, partner, and software supplier relationships, ensuring strong commercial outcomes, innovation, and value for money

About you

15+ years' experience leading enterprise technology products, platforms, digital services, or engineering organisations 

Demonstrated success leading large multidisciplinary teams across product, platform, engineering, delivery, and operational functions 

Experienceestablishingand scaling modern product and platform operating models 

Strong experience across enterprise platforms such as CRM, ERP, digital workplace, and care or customer-facing systems

What we can offer you

We care about your wellbeing at HammondCare and as a result offer a wide range of health and lifestyle benefits including:

NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free) 

Additional leave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave 

Flexible working options 

Discounts on everyday products and services 

Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families 

Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families 

Health & Wellbeing programmes 

Reward & Recognition programmes 

Referral bonuses 

Career and professional development opportunities 

Our Culture

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive to create an equal employment environment for all.

Ifyou'rea strategic technology leader who can combine vision, execution, engineering excellence, and business value delivery,we'dlove to hear from you.

To Apply

If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now!

All short-listed applicants for these positions will be asked to consent to a criminal record check and references.    Click here to Apply now →

Exciting Federal Government Opportunity   
  APS6 Support Needs Assessor  
 50 Federal-government opportunities available across Australia 
   
  Reasons to Apply - At a Glance  
 
 Meaningful, participant-focused work - play a key role in shaping outcomes for people with disability through high-quality, person-centred assessments. 
 Join a growing Federal Government agency with a strong focus on operational excellence and career development. 
 Enjoy stability with a hybrid work model, competitive hourly rate, and potential for extension or permanency. 
 
   
  Mandatory requirements:  
 
 Australian Citizenship 
 A recognised tertiary qualification in an allied health or relevant clinical discipline (i.e. Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, Social Work, Psychology, Nursing or similar). 
 
   
  Your New Company  
 Your organisation delivers a national support system for Australians living with disability, funding essential services tailored to individual needs and helping people achieve their goals. As a growing Federal Government agency focused on operational excellence, this role offers a chance to contribute to meaningful initiatives and take your career to the next level. 
   
  Your New Role  
 You will be responsible for: 
 
 Conducting comprehensive support needs assessments by engaging with participants and their representatives to gather detailed, accurate information, ensuring a respectful, trauma-informed and person-centred approach throughout the process. 
 Analysing, interpreting and synthesising complex information and external evidence to develop clear, evidence-based assessments that accurately reflect individual circumstances and inform appropriate support outcomes. 
 Preparing high-quality written assessment reports that are clear, consistent and aligned with legislative and policy frameworks, ensuring decisions are transparent, defensible and uphold ethical standards. 
 Communicating effectively with participants, families and stakeholders across a range of channels, explaining assessment processes and outcomes in a way that is accessible, inclusive and easy to understand. 
 
   
   
  What You Will Need to Succeed  
 The successful applicant will demonstrate: 
 
 A recognised tertiary qualification in an allied health or relevant clinical discipline (such as Occupational Therapy, Physiotherapy, Social Work, Psychology, Nursing or similar), is a requirement for the role. 
 Strong assessment capability and background, with the ability to gather, interpret and synthesise complex information to support clear, evidence-based decision-making. 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to convey complex or sensitive information in a clear, respectful and accessible way across diverse audiences. 
 Sound judgement and problem-solving ability, with experience applying policy and managing risk to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes in a complex environment. 
 
   
  The Logistics  
 
 Contract until December 31st, 2026, with a view of extension or permanency. 
 Full-time & Hybrid working arrangement. 
 Hourly rate of $61.86 + super. 
 Australian Citizenship & tertiary qualification (proof required) is mandatory. 
 Opportunities in Darwin. 
 
   
  What You'll Get in Return  
 
 An opportunity to progress your career with a large Federal Government agency. 
 Work-from-home flexibility and a hot desk office environment. 
 A positive and open working culture. 
 Initial 2-week's training provided (on-site mandatory) 
 Weekly pay cycle. 
 Online timesheet submission and approval. 
 Nominated superannuation fund. 
 
   
  What You Need to Do Now  
 If this role sounds like something you'd be interested in pursuing, click 'Apply Now' or forward your current CV to Tom.James@hays.com.au. Please include a short summary outlining your suitability for the role, along with the location to which you are applying. 
   
 *Due to the high volume of applications we are currently receiving, we may not be able to respond to every email. We appreciate your patience during this busy period* 
    Please  click here  to apply.

Lead electrical mining projects from concept to commissioning while enjoying a 5:2 roster   Your new company  
 Our client is a leading Australian resources organisation with a strong commitment to operational excellence, safety, and sustainable project delivery. With a substantial portfolio of capital projects and ongoing investment in site infrastructure, they offer the opportunity to work on complex projects within a collaborative and high-performing team environment. 
   Your new role  
 As an Electrical Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing electrical capital projects through the full project life cycle, from early studies and detailed design through to construction, commissioning, and handover. You will work closely with consultants, contractors, and key stakeholders to deliver projects safely, on schedule, and within budget. 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Managing electrical projects from concept development through to completion 
 Coordinating consultants during feasibility studies, engineering, and detailed design phases 
 Managing project budgets, schedules, risks, and reporting requirements 
 Overseeing contractors and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations 
 Leading project execution, construction activities, and commissioning works 
 Reviewing and managing project documentation, technical deliverables, and governance requirements 
 Collaborating with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external stakeholders 
 Ensuring all work is delivered in line with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements 
 Driving project performance and continuous improvement outcomes 
 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Demonstrated experience managing electrical projects within mining, resources, heavy industry, energy, or infrastructure environments 
 Proven experience managing consultants through study, design, and project delivery phases 
 Strong understanding of project delivery methodologies and project governance requirements 
 Experience managing contractors during construction and commissioning activities 
 Sound knowledge of contract administration and contractor management 
 Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, and leadership skills 
 Ability to manage multiple project priorities in a dynamic operational environment 
 Electrical trade or engineering qualifications will be highly regarded. 
 Commitment to maintaining the highest safety standards 
 
   What you'll get in return  
 This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly regarded mining operation and contribute to the successful delivery of critical electrical infrastructure projects. You'll work on a Monday-to-Thursday site roster with the flexibility to work from home on Fridays, while camp accommodation is provided throughout your assignment. Both FIFO and DIDO options are available, offering flexibility for candidates across Queensland. You'll join a supportive team environment where your expertise will directly influence the success of key site projects and future growth initiatives. 
   What you need to do now  
 If you're interested in this role, applications can be submitted via the "apply now" button. Please ensure you are submitting an up-to-date CV. If you have any further questions, please call Jennah Murray 07 4960 1129. 
   
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

Dalwallinu, Full Time, Trades & Services
Vacancy Listing Dates 15/07/2026 to 12/08/2026
Please Quote Reference Number 17668
- Multiple opportunities available for DIDO positions
- Remuneration between $79,423 - $130,000 based on role and experience
- Join our team at Dallcon - Based in Dalwallinu

DALLCON has been manufacturing and supplying precast and custom concrete products to the Western Australian civil, mining, and agricultural industries since 2000.

Due to continued growth within our team, we are currently looking for experienced workers to join our team based in Dalwallinu. These are Monday to Friday DIDO roles. See below descriptions for each role:

CIVIL ENGINEERING DRAFTSPERSON
This position involves preparing detailed drawings and plans for civil engineering projects, supporting Civil Engineering Professionals and Engineering Technologists. Registration or licensing may be required.

TRUCK DRIVER (GENERAL)
Operates a large truck that necessitates a specially endorsed class of license for the transportation of oversized goods. Registration or licensing is required.

CONCRETE BATCHING PLANT OPERATOR
Operates a mixing plant to produce batches of concrete using cement, sand, aggregate, water, and various other ingredients.

EARTHMOVING PLANT OPERATOR (GENERAL)
Operates a variety of earthmoving equipment to facilitate the construction of roads, railways, water supply systems, dams, treatment plants, and agricultural earthworks. Registration or licensing is required.

LOADER OPERATOR
Operates a motorized loader to transport and load soil, rock, and various other materials. Registration or licensing is required.

MOBILE PLANT OPERATOR NEC
This occupational category includes Mobile Plant Operators who are not classified elsewhere. Registration or licensing may be required.

PROCUREMENT MANAGER
The individual is responsible for planning, organizing, directing, controlling, and coordinating the procurement and purchasing of materials, products, and services for the organization.

STEEL FIXER
The role involves positioning and securing steel bars and steel mesh within concrete forms to reinforce concrete structures. Registration or licensing may be required.

STRUCTURAL ENGINEER
The role involves analyzing the structural properties of various types of constructions, testing the behaviour and durability of materials utilized in their fabrication, and designing as well as overseeing the construction of diverse structures. It is important to note that registration or licensing may be required for this profession.

STONEMASON
Cuts and shapes both hard and soft stone blocks, as well as masonry slabs, to build and restore stone structures. Interprets plans and specifications to determine required materials, measurements, and installation methods.

To be considered for the above roles, you will need at least 3 years' experience in the role you're applying for.

JOIN A REWARDING CULTURE:

We strive to foster a working environment that supports every individual to attain their best potential with a wide range of employee benefits and ongoing opportunity to develop individual capacity, including:
- Employee recognition programs
- Learning and development opportunities
- Career growth within a growth organisation
- Remuneration between $79,423 to $130,000 (negotiated based on role and experience)

Dallcon guarantees to keep your inquiry confidential. Residency and police checks will be required to verify work entitlements.

Only successful applicants will be contacted following shortlisting.

APPLY NOW through our online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17668.php

Location:	Penrith, NSW, 2750
Full-Time:	Immediate start
Reports to:   Manager
Job Title:	Residential Care Officer
Salary Range:	$79,500 - $85,000
Job Closes Date	30 Days  

About the Client
Our client delivers person-centred care to older Australians, supporting them to live independently with dignity. As a Residential Care Officer, you will coordinate holistic care plans, liaise with families and health professionals, and ensure residents’ wellbeing is prioritized. This role is pivotal in creating a supportive, home-like environment.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
Client Assessment & Care Planning
• Conduct comprehensive assessments of residents’ physical, social, and emotional needs, and collaboratively develop individualized care and support programs.
• Interview residents and their families to identify the nature and extent of difficulties, adjusting care plans accordingly.

Program Implementation & Monitoring
• Implement educational, training, and lifestyle programs that promote engagement and wellbeing, including social activities and health education.
• Monitor residents’ progress routinely, documenting changes and reporting outcomes to the clinical team and families.

Community Liaison & Referral
• Identify community resources and services—such as health, welfare, housing, and allied health—and refer residents and families to additional support.
• Liaise with community groups, government bodies, and private providers to raise awareness of available services and advocate for residents’ needs.

Reporting & Funding
• Prepare detailed submissions for funding and resources, ensuring compliance with Aged Care standards.
• Report to government agencies and other bodies on resident outcomes, service gaps, and program effectiveness.

Requirements
• Diploma or higher in Community Services, Aged Care, or related field.
• Minimum of 1 year experience in aged care assessment, care planning, and case management.
• Strong communication skills, with ability to engage families, agencies, and multidisciplinary teams.
• Knowledge of My Aged Care, funding frameworks, and reporting requirements.
• Current police check and driver’s license.

Apply now 
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience. Applications will be reviewed as received, therefore, please apply as soon as possible before the closing date.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.
